The lane sizes measured on 2026-11-19, at variant=release: native, clang-21 on Darwin arm64, the Mach-O executable stripped, whose segments are page-aligned: a small cell can add fewer raw bytes than its code, which its gzip -9n bytes show better; wasip2, clang-wasip2, the .wasm; wasip3, clang-wasip3, the .wasm; emscripten, emscripten-6.0.11, the .wasm and its .js.

|===

OpenSSL: its cells differ by a few bytes whatever the operation: each fetches its algorithm by name from OpenSSL's default provider (link:https://docs.openssl.org/3.5/man7/crypto/[OpenSSL 3.5's crypto(7), algorithm fetching]), and a static link brings the provider's algorithms with it, not the operation's alone.
